_about: The contested issues the Positions page groups voices under. An issue with a headline shows that Overview headline's cited text and links its sections; one without names its own sections and an optional link. Topics pick the media items that count as voices on it. Titles are labels, not claims about the bill. An issue may list disputes: one question, the bill passages it turns on (located and cited by tools/build.py), and the outside readings (data/takes.json) on each side. A side with no reading shows as none found; the page does not pick a winner.
